_comment: Example output of lib/domains_generator.py. Copy the generator's real output here as config/domains.json (gitignored, site-specific) after running it against your own BACH install. 'experts[]' is provenance/grouping metadata only -- the ticket-master prompt routes directly to standalone_skill / matched_skills, never to the expert name itself.

domains.label: Example Domain
domains.description: Example boss agent. Use this skill when: (1) doing thing one, (2) doing thing two.
domains._comment_usecase_skills: Phase 1b (T-20260913-150720021): skills covering a usecase of the BOSS itself, belonging to none of its experts -- they appear in no experts[] entry. The full skill name must occur as whole tokens in the usecase text, so expect too few entries rather than wrong ones.

experts._comment: Stage 1 (exact): a provenance link was found. Routes directly to this one skill.
experts.name: example-expert-exact

experts._comment: Stage 2 (fuzzy, since v1.8.0): no single provenance link, but this expert governs a whole skill FAMILY -- matched via KEYWORD_CATEGORY_HINTS/token overlap in lib/domains_generator.py::fuzzy_match_skills(). Route to ALL listed skills, not just the first.
experts.name: example-expert-family

experts._comment: Neither stage found anything -- flag as a GAP in the ticket's ENDPOINT field instead of silently falling back.
experts.name: example-expert-gap

domains._comment: Stage 0 (domain-level, T-20260808-02): a standalone skill can supersede a WHOLE boss agent instead of any one of its named experts. Applied to every expert that lacks a stronger match (never overwrites 'status': 'portiert'); 'match': 'domain' marks it distinctly from stage-1 'exact' and stage-2 'fuzzy'.
domains.label: Example Domain Covered By One Skill
domains.description: Example boss agent whose sub-experts are all covered by a single, more general standalone skill.

experts._comment: This expert's own name/description never matched anything in stage 1 or 2, but the domain-level skill covers it too.
experts.name: example-sub-expert

domains._comment: Stage 0 also covers a boss agent with ZERO orchestrated experts (orchestrates.experts: [] in its own SKILL.md frontmatter) -- there is nowhere to attach a per-expert match, so a synthetic pseudo-expert carries it instead. The '__domain__:' prefix never collides with a real BACH expert name (those come from orchestrates.experts frontmatter, never contain '::' or this prefix).
domains.label: Example Domain With No Orchestrated Experts
domains.description: Example boss agent whose frontmatter lists no sub-experts at all.
usecases: Example boss agent whose frontmatter lists no sub-experts at all
